posts.name: Yash Rastogi
posts.cooked:
The OPPE will have easy, medium and hard difficulty level questions broadly based on:

  1. bash scripts - (control flow)
  2. grep, sed & awk - (pattern matching & substitution)
  3. basic usage of commands like date + command chaining + column transformation etc.

Note: This is a non-exhaustive list. For a complete overview, go through all the assignments on portal and the VM.

posts.name: Yash Rastogi
posts.cooked:
Sequence wise answers:

  1. Syllabus: Weeks 1-9.
  2. Another oppe specific VM will be provisioned.
    • Key will be already set, no need to ssh-keygen.
    • Just the link will change.
  3. man page and cheat sheet will be available.
  4. For date and time duration, you can refer the grading document.
  5. For prep, you can use existing resources on VM, discourse, YT etc.
  6. Number of questions is TBD but you can expect 6 for now.
